title: How Michael De Santa faked his own death in GTA 5
subject: michael
description:
Would you have taken Michael's deal with the FIB? 👇

How Michael Townley sold out his crew, faked his death and became Michael De Santa. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto V.

scenes.text: Michael De Santa had to die to keep his family.
In 2004, under his real name, Michael Townley, he robbed a bank in snowy North Yankton with his partners Trevor and Brad.
But the job was a setup. Michael had secretly made a deal with FIB agent Dave Norton.
Brad was shot and killed. Trevor escaped, believing his best friend Michael was dead too.
Michael got a new name, a Los Santos mansion, and a family that could barely stand him.
He faked his death for that perfect life, and it was slowly killing him.
